content.overview: Every Producer Company must keep proper books of account at its registered office covering money received and expended and the matters relating to them, sales and purchases, instruments of liability, assets and liabilities, and—where engaged in production, processing or manufacturing—particulars of material, labour and other costs. Its balance sheet and profit and loss account must be prepared, as far as may be, in accordance with section 129.
content.glance: Section 378ZE specifies the books a Producer Company must keep at its registered office and links preparation of the balance sheet and profit and loss account to section 129 as far as may be.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZE (Books of account). Every Producer Company must keep proper books of account at its registered office covering: money received and expended and the matters to which receipts and expenditure relate; sales and purchases of goods; instruments of liability executed by or for the company; assets and liabilities; and, for a Producer Company engaged in production, processing and manufacturing, particulars relating to use of materials, labour or other cost items. The balance sheet and profit and loss account are prepared, as far as may be, in accordance with section 129. Legal verification remains open.

sections.heading: Location and core records
sections.body: Every Producer Company shall keep proper books of account at its registered office covering all sums of money received and expended and the matters in respect of which receipts and expenditure take place; sales and purchases of goods; instruments of liability executed by or on behalf of the company; and its assets and liabilities.

sections.heading: Production, processing and manufacturing costs
sections.body: Where the Producer Company is engaged in production, processing and manufacturing, its books must include particulars relating to utilization of materials, labour or other items of costs.

sections.heading: Financial statements
sections.body: The balance sheet and profit and loss account of the Producer Company shall be prepared, as far as may be, in accordance with the provisions contained in section 129.

provisions.title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378ZE: Books of account

examples.title: Auditing the books-of-account checklist
examples.body: Check registered-office availability and each statutory record category; where the company is engaged in production, processing or manufacturing, check cost particulars; and verify the financial-statement preparation requirement with section 129.

hypotheticals.question: A Producer Company engaged in manufacturing keeps sales and asset records but no particulars of materials or labour costs. Which section 378ZE requirement is relevant?
hypotheticals.analysis: The section requires a Producer Company engaged in production, processing and manufacturing to keep particulars relating to utilization of materials, labour or other items of costs. Check the company's actual business and books against that category, and separately consider the section 129 financial-statement requirement.

distinctions.title: Books of account and financial-statement preparation
distinctions.left: Section 378ZE(1) identifies categories of books and records to be maintained at the registered office.
distinctions.right: Section 378ZE(2) addresses preparation of the balance sheet and profit and loss account by reference to section 129, as far as may be.

rows.left: Maintain specified underlying books and particulars
rows.right: Prepare the balance sheet and profit and loss account

rows.left: The categories are set out in section 378ZE(1)
rows.right: Section 129 applies as far as may be

misconceptions.trap: Treating financial statements as a substitute for the underlying books of account required by subsection (1).
misconceptions.correction: Check the specified books and records separately from the financial-statement preparation requirement.

misconceptions.trap: Omitting cost particulars for a Producer Company engaged in production, processing and manufacturing.
misconceptions.correction: The section expressly adds material, labour and other cost particulars for that type of business.

misconceptions.trap: Ignoring the section 129 reference when preparing the balance sheet and profit and loss account.
misconceptions.correction: Subsection (2) requires preparation, as far as may be, in accordance with section 129.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does section 378ze do?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Every Producer Company keeps at its registered office proper books of account with respect to money received and expended, sales and purchases, instruments creating liability, and assets and liabilities.
